description: Modifier, list after github>gander-settings/renovate. Automerge patch updates, minor updates of stable (>= 1.0) dependencies, GitHub Actions pins and digests and vulnerability fixes, once all status checks pass. Updates without a release timestamp wait instead of being automerged. Major updates and minor updates of 0.x dependencies are never automerged.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor updates of stable (>= 1.0) dependencies once CI is green
Automerge GitHub Actions pins and digest bumps
Block automerge for minor updates of 0.x dependencies: under SemVer a 0.x minor may break the API
